title.zh: 规定省与市镇官员及雇员薪金应以菲律宾货币定额，数额与现行法律所规定的墨西哥货币数额相同；规定现行法律授权以墨西哥货币征收、课征与收取的税款、公费及其他课征，应按一菲律宾比索兑一墨西哥比索之汇率改以菲律宾货币缴纳；规定现行法律所规定的岛屿或省级官员与雇员一切薪酬、以及一切官方规费与收费，均应按一菲律宾比索兑一墨西哥比索之汇率改以菲律宾货币缴纳的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE SALARIES OF PROVINCIAL AND MUNICIPAL OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES SHALL BE FIXED IN PHILIPPINE CURRENCY AT THE SAME AMOUNTS NOW ALLOWED BY LAW TO BE FIXED IN MEXICAN CURRENCY, AND THAT THE ASSESSMENT, IMPOSITION, AND COLLECTION OF TAXES, PUBLIC DUES, AND IMPOSITIONS NOW AUTHORIZED AND MADE PAYABLE BY LAW IN MEXICAN CURRENCY SHALL BE MADE PAYABLE IN PHILIPPINE CURRENCY ON THE BASIS OF ONE PHILIPPINE PESO FOR ONE MEXICAN DOLLAR, AND THAT ALL COMPENSATION FOR INSULAR OR PROVINCIAL OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES AND ALL OFFICIAL FEES AND CHARGES NOW MADE BY LAW PAYABLE IN MEXICAN CURRENCY SHALL BE PAYABLE IN PHILIPPINE CURRENCY ON THE BASIS OF ONE PHILIPPINE PESO FOR ONE MEXICAN DOLLAR.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE SALARIES OF PROVINCIAL AND MUNICIPAL OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES SHALL BE FIXED IN PHILIPPINE CURRENCY AT THE SAME AMOUNTS NOW ALLOWED BY LAW TO BE FIXED IN MEXICAN CURRENCY, AND THAT THE ASSESSMENT, IMPOSITION, AND COLLECTION OF TAXES, PUBLIC DUES, AND IMPOSITIONS NOW AUTHORIZED AND MADE PAYABLE BY LAW IN MEXICAN CURRENCY SHALL BE MADE PAYABLE IN PHILIPPINE CURRENCY ON THE BASIS OF ONE PHILIPPINE PESO FOR ONE MEXICAN DOLLAR, AND THAT ALL COMPENSATION FOR INSULAR OR PROVINCIAL OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES AND ALL OFFICIAL FEES AND CHARGES NOW MADE BY LAW PAYABLE IN MEXICAN CURRENCY SHALL BE PAYABLE IN PHILIPPINE CURRENCY ON THE BASIS OF ONE PHILIPPINE PESO FOR ONE MEXICAN DOLLAR.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định mức lương của cán bộ và nhân viên tỉnh, huyện phải được xác định bằng tiền Philippines với số tiền bằng mức hiện được pháp luật cho phép tính bằng tiền Mexico; thuế, lệ phí công cộng và các khoản thu khác hiện được pháp luật cho phép thu bằng tiền Mexico phải được nộp bằng tiền Philippines theo tỷ giá một peso Philippines đổi một đô la Mexico; và toàn bộ thù lao cho cán bộ, nhân viên thuộc đảo hoặc tỉnh cùng mọi lệ phí và khoản thu chính thức hiện được pháp luật quy định nộp bằng tiền Mexico phải nộp bằng tiền Philippines theo tỷ giá một peso Philippines đổi một đô la Mexico
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดว่าเงินเดือนของเจ้าหน้าที่และพนักงานระดับจังหวัดและเทศบาลจะต้องกำหนดเป็นเงินฟิลิปปินส์ในจำนวนเท่ากับที่กฎหมายปัจจุบันกำหนดให้เป็นเงินเม็กซิโกและกำหนดว่าการประเมินการเรียกเก็บและการเก็บภาษีค่าธรรมเนียมสาธารณะและภาระอื่นๆที่กฎหมายปัจจุบันอนุญาตให้เรียกเก็บได้เป็นเงินเม็กซิโกจะต้องเรียกเก็บเป็นเงินฟิลิปปินส์ตามอัตราหนึ่งเปโซฟิลิปปินส์ต่อหนึ่งดอลลาร์เม็กซิโกและกำหนดว่าค่าตอบแทนทั้งหมดสำหรับเจ้าหน้าที่และพนักงานระดับเกาะหรือจังหวัดและค่าธรรมเนียมอย่างเป็นทางการทั้งหมดที่กฎหมายปัจจุบันกำหนดให้ชำระเป็นเงินเม็กซิโกจะต้องชำระเป็นเงินฟิลิปปินส์ตามอัตราหนึ่งเปโซฟิลิปปินส์ต่อหนึ่งดอลลาร์เม็กซิโก
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan bahwa gaji pejabat dan pegawai provinsi serta kotamadya harus ditetapkan dalam mata uang Filipina pada jumlah yang sama dengan jumlah yang saat ini diizinkan oleh undang-undang ditetapkan dalam mata uang Meksiko; penilaian pembebanan dan penagihan pajak retribusi umum dan beban lainnya yang saat ini diizinkan dan dibayarkan menurut undang-undang dalam mata uang Meksiko harus dibayarkan dalam mata uang Filipina dengan dasar satu peso Filipina untuk satu dolar Meksiko; serta seluruh kompensasi bagi pejabat atau pegawai insular atau provinsi dan semua biaya resmi serta pungutan yang saat ini ditetapkan oleh undang-undang dibayarkan dalam mata uang Meksiko harus dibayarkan dalam mata uang Filipina dengan dasar satu peso Filipina untuk satu dolar Meksiko
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa gaji pegawai dan kakitangan peringkat wilayah dan perbandaran akan ditetapkan dalam mata wang Filipina pada jumlah yang sama seperti yang dibenarkan oleh undang-undang semasa ditetapkan dalam mata wang Mexico dan bahawa penilaian pemungutan dan kutipan cukai yuran awam dan beban lain yang kini dibenarkan dan dibayar mengikut undang-undang dalam mata wang Mexico akan dibayar dalam mata wang Filipina berdasarkan satu peso Filipina kepada satu dolar Mexico dan bahawa semua bayaran kompensasi kepada pegawai atau kakitangan pulau atau wilayah dan semua yuran rasmi dan caj yang kini ditetapkan oleh undang-undang dibayar dalam mata wang Mexico akan dibayar dalam mata wang Filipina berdasarkan satu peso Filipina kepada satu dolar Mexico

text.en:
All provincial treasurers, municipal councils, and other authorities of every kind in the Philippine
Islands who have authority to fix the salaries of municipal officers and employees are hereby authorized and
directed to fix such salaries in Philippine currency, instead of in Mexican currency, anything in existing law
to the contrary notwithstanding. All such salaries heretofore fixed in Mexican currency shall, after January
first, nineteen hundred and four, be payable in Philippine currency at the same amounts as now provided by
law in Mexican currency and shall remain fixed at such amounts in Philippine currency until changed by
competent authority.

On and after the first day of January, nineteen hundred and four, all public dues, internal revenues,
industrial, stamp, forestry, cedilla, license, and municipal taxes of every kind, and all fines and penalties
imposed by courts or other authorities, shall be imposed, assessed, and collected in Philippine currency
instead of in Mexican currency as now provided by law, and at the same amounts in Philippine currency as
are now fixed by law for such taxes. fines, and penalties in Mexican currency Provided, however, That
Spanish-Filipino coins may be received in payment of such taxes, fines, and penalties at the official ratio that
shall from time, to time prevail until such time as Spanish-Filipino coins shall by law cease to he receivable
for public dues.

On and after January first, nineteen hundred and four, all compensation that is provided by law for
Insular or provincial officers and employees, wherever such compensation is fixed in Mexican currency, and
all official fees and diary's. Insular, provincial, or municipal, wherever such fees are fixed in Mexican
currency, shall be payable in Philippine currency on the basis of one Philippine peso for one Mexican dollar.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 28, 1903.
